title: A C¹ submanifold has an approximate tangent space at each of its points
statement: Let m ≥ 1, N ∈ ℕ and S ⊆ ℝ^N with IsC1Submanifold m S. Then for every x ∈ S there is a linear subspace P of ℝ^N that is the approximate tangent space of S at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4 with Hᵐ := μHE[m] (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m S x P). That is, finrank P = m and ∫_{η_{x,r}(S)} f dHᵐ → ∫_P f dHᵐ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ). (P is the classical tangent space Dφ(v₀)(ℝᵐ) of any chart φ with φ(v₀) = x.)
lean_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → ∀ (S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))), IsC1Submanifold m S → ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m S x P
